blocks.text: Schools, Parks & Commuting in Sardis East Vedder

parts.t: Families looking at homes for sale in Sardis East Vedder are served by Sardis Elementary, Tyson Elementary, Vedder Middle School, and Sardis Secondary School (45460 Stevenson Road) in SD33. Outdoor recreation and community amenities nearby include Sardis Park (6898 School Lane, with its 655-metre pond loop trail, playgrounds, and picnic areas) and nearby Sardis Library and Sardis Sports Complex. For commuters and transit riders, the area is served by BC Transit Route 51 (Vedder corridor), Route 54 (Promontory–Cottonwood Mall via Stevenson and Wiltshire), and Route 66 Fraser Valley Express at Vedder and Luckakuck.

blocks.text: Zoning, Land Use Plans & Buyer Due Diligence in Sardis East Vedder

parts.t: Land use and building permits in Sardis East Vedder are regulated by the Sardis Neighbourhood Plan (OCP Schedule D, Bylaw No. 5024), Chilliwack 2050 OCP infill guidelines, and the City's Vedder River Alluvial Fan Floodplain Regulation Bylaw. Before removing subjects on a property in Sardis East Vedder, verify the title search (checking for statutory building schemes, easements, geotechnical or floodplain covenants, and freehold vs. leasehold tenure) and estimate your closing taxes with our

Which schools serve Sardis East Vedder in Chilliwack School District 33?

Schools serving or located near Sardis East Vedder include Sardis Elementary, Tyson Elementary, Vedder Middle School, and Sardis Secondary School (45460 Stevenson Road) in SD33. How are roads, highway access, and public transit in Sardis East Vedder?

Key road corridors serving Sardis East Vedder include Vedder Road, Knight Road, Promontory Road, Stevenson Road, and Highway 1 Exit 119. Public transit connections include BC Transit Route 51 (Vedder corridor), Route 54 (Promontory–Cottonwood Mall via Stevenson and Wiltshire), and Route 66 Fraser Valley Express at Vedder and Luckakuck.
What zoning, Official Community Plan, or hazard rules apply in Sardis East Vedder?

Properties in Sardis East Vedder are governed by the Sardis Neighbourhood Plan (OCP Schedule D, Bylaw No. 5024), Chilliwack 2050 OCP infill guidelines, and the City's Vedder River Alluvial Fan Floodplain Regulation Bylaw. Before writing an offer, check the parcel's exact zoning, Development Permit Area overlays, and floodplain elevation requirements.
Are homes in Sardis East Vedder freehold or leasehold?

Most residential properties in Sardis East Vedder are freehold (fee simple) or freehold strata, though select developments in the broader Chilliwack and Cultus Lake region sit on prepaid leasehold land.
